# Leegtech

> Leegtech provides end-to-end patent, trademark, copyright, design, business registration, compliance and legal drafting services across India, with international filing support.

Leegtech (Leegtech Private Limited) is based in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India and serves clients across India, with international patent, design, trademark and copyright filings. Founder: Anmol Shrivastava.
Contact: +91 89823 46105 (phone/WhatsApp), info@leegtech.in. Office: Gincube Center, Smart City Office, Moti Mahal, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh 474001. A free initial consultation is offered.

## Practice areas
- [Patent](https://leegtech.in/patent/): Protect Your Invention. Build Without Borders. 12 services.
- [Design](https://leegtech.in/design/): Your Product's Look Is Worth Protecting. 3 services.
- [Trademark & Copyright](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/): Your Brand. Protected. Recognised. 9 services.
- [Business & Tax](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/): Start. Register. Grow. Stay Compliant. 12 services.
- [Legal](https://leegtech.in/legal/): Agreements That Protect Your Business. 10 services.

## Services
### Patent
- [Patent Search (Prior Art Search)](https://leegtech.in/patent/patent-search/): Know whether your invention is new before you spend on filing.
- [Provisional Patent Application](https://leegtech.in/patent/provisional-patent-application/): Secure your filing date while you finish developing the invention.
- [Patent Registration (Complete Specification & Grant)](https://leegtech.in/patent/patent-registration/): End-to-end complete specification drafting, filing and prosecution to grant.
- [Response to First Examination Report (FER)](https://leegtech.in/patent/fer-response/): Well-argued replies to patent office objections, on time.
- [Patent Hearing Representation](https://leegtech.in/patent/patent-hearing/): Representation before the Controller at Indian Patent Office hearings.
- [Patent Renewal & Maintenance](https://leegtech.in/patent/patent-renewal/): Keep your patent alive with on-time renewals and working statements.
- [Technical Amendment of Patent](https://leegtech.in/patent/patent-amendment/): Correct errors and refine claims in a filed or granted patent.
- [Pre-Grant Patent Opposition](https://leegtech.in/patent/pre-grant-opposition/): Challenge a published patent application before it is granted.
- [Post-Grant Patent Opposition](https://leegtech.in/patent/post-grant-opposition/): Challenge a granted patent within one year of grant publication.
- [PCT International Patent Application](https://leegtech.in/patent/pct-application/): One application to keep patent options open in 150+ countries.
- [USA Patent Application](https://leegtech.in/patent/us-patent-application/): Direct patent filing with the USPTO, from India.
- [UK Patent Application](https://leegtech.in/patent/uk-patent-application/): Direct patent filing with the UK Intellectual Property Office.

### Design
- [Indian Design Registration](https://leegtech.in/design/design-registration/): Protect the shape, pattern and visual appearance of your product.
- [UK Design Registration](https://leegtech.in/design/uk-design-registration/): Protect your product designs in the United Kingdom.
- [Utility Model in Germany (Gebrauchsmuster)](https://leegtech.in/design/germany-utility-model/): Fast, registration-based protection for technical inventions in Germany.

### Trademark & Copyright
- [Trademark Search](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/trademark-search/): Clearance search before you invest in a brand name or logo.
- [Trademark Registration](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/trademark-registration/): Register your brand name, logo or tagline across India.
- [Trademark Objection Reply](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/trademark-objection-reply/): Strong replies to examination reports from the Trade Marks Registry.
- [Trademark Opposition](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/trademark-opposition/): Oppose a conflicting mark, or defend your application against opposition.
- [Trademark Hearing](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/trademark-hearing/): Representation at show-cause and opposition hearings.
- [Trademark Renewal](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/trademark-renewal/): Renew your registered trademark every 10 years and avoid removal.
- [International Trademark (Madrid Protocol)](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/international-trademark-registration/): Protect your brand in 130+ countries through one application.
- [Indian Copyright Registration](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/copyright-registration/): Register books, software, music, art, films and other creative works.
- [Canada Copyright Registration](https://leegtech.in/trademark-copyright/canada-copyright-registration/): Register your creative works with the Canadian Intellectual Property Office.

### Business & Tax
- [Private Limited Company Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/private-limited-company-registration/): Incorporate your Pvt Ltd company with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
- [LLP Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/llp-registration/): Register a Limited Liability Partnership with flexible management.
- [One Person Company (OPC) Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/one-person-company-registration/): A company structure for solo founders, with limited liability.
- [Section 8 Company (Non-Profit) Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/section-8-company-registration/): Register a non-profit company for charitable and social objectives.
- [Startup India (DPIIT) Recognition](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/startup-india-registration/): Get DPIIT startup recognition and unlock government benefits.
- [MSME (Udyam) Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/msme-udyam-registration/): Register your enterprise on the Udyam portal and access MSME benefits.
- [GST Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/gst-registration/): Get your GSTIN quickly and correctly.
- [Income Tax & TDS Return Filing](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/income-tax-tds-return/): Accurate ITR and quarterly TDS filings for individuals and businesses.
- [Shops & Establishment Registration](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/shop-and-establishment-registration/): Register your shop, office or business establishment under state law.
- [FSSAI Registration & Licence](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/fssai-registration/): Food business registration or licence on the FoSCoS portal.
- [ISO Certification](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/iso-certification/): Choose the right ISO standard and get certified by an accredited body.
- [Pvt Ltd & LLP Annual Compliance](https://leegtech.in/business-tax/annual-compliance/): Stay compliant with MCA and tax filings, on time, every year.

- [IP Licensing Agreement](https://leegtech.in/legal/licensing-agreement/): License your patents, trademarks, copyright or technology for revenue.

- [Vendor Agreement](https://leegtech.in/legal/vendor-agreement/): Protect your supply and service relationships.
- [Contract Drafting & Review](https://leegtech.in/legal/contract-drafting/): Clear, enforceable business contracts drafted or reviewed by experts.
- [Merger Agreement](https://leegtech.in/legal/merger-agreement/): Documentation for company mergers and amalgamations.
- [Acquisition Agreement](https://leegtech.in/legal/acquisition-agreement/): Share purchase and business transfer documentation, with IP due diligence.

## Guides
- [Trademark Objection Reply: Section 9 vs Section 11 Objections](https://leegtech.in/blog/trademark-objection-section-9-vs-11/): Trademark examination report in India? Section 9 (absolute) vs Section 11 (relative) objections, the one-month deadline and how to reply.
- [Trademark Opposition in India: Timeline and Process](https://leegtech.in/blog/trademark-opposition-india/): How trademark opposition works in India: the four-month window after advertisement, counter-statement, evidence, hearing and decision, step by step.
- [Design Registration in India: Process, Term and Documents](https://leegtech.in/blog/design-registration-india/): How to register a design in India under the Designs Act, 2000: what can be registered, the novelty test, documents, the process and the 10 + 5 year term.
- [Statement of Working of Patents (Form 27) Explained](https://leegtech.in/blog/form-27-statement-of-working-india/): Every patentee and licensee in India must file Form 27 on working of the patent. Who files, when (every three financial years since 2024) and what it asks.
- [Foreign Filing Permission under Section 39: Filing Abroad from India](https://leegtech.in/blog/foreign-filing-permission-section-39/): Indian residents need a permit or a prior Indian filing before applying for a patent abroad. Section 39, Form 25 and the consequences of getting it wrong.
- [Patent Search: How to Check If Your Invention Is New](https://leegtech.in/blog/patent-search-india/): How to run a patent search before filing in India: why novelty is judged worldwide, the free official databases to use, and a step-by-step search method.
- [Can Software Be Patented in India? Section 3(k) and the CRI Guidelines 2025](https://leegtech.in/blog/software-patent-india/): Software as such cannot be patented in India, but software-led inventions with a technical effect can be. Section 3(k) and the CRI Guidelines 2025 explained.
- [Pre-grant vs Post-grant Patent Opposition in India](https://leegtech.in/blog/pre-grant-vs-post-grant-opposition-india/): How pre-grant and post-grant patent opposition work in India under Section 25: who can file, the grounds, time limits and the procedure for each.
- [Patent Renewal in India: When Fees Are Due and What If You Miss Them](https://leegtech.in/blog/patent-renewal-india/): When patent renewal fees fall due in India, the six-month extension, paying after a late grant, and how to restore a patent that has lapsed for non-payment.
- [PCT Application from India: Timeline and National Phase Explained](https://leegtech.in/blog/pct-application-from-india/): How a PCT application filed from India works: the 12-month priority window, international search, publication and the 31-month national phase in India.
- [Expedited Patent Examination in India: Who Is Eligible?](https://leegtech.in/blog/expedited-patent-examination-india/): Expedited examination under rule 24C can speed up a patent application in India. See who is eligible, how to request it and the shorter timelines.
- [How to Respond to a First Examination Report (FER) in India](https://leegtech.in/blog/fer-response-india/): Received a First Examination Report from the Indian Patent Office? Learn the six-month deadline, common objections and how to prepare a strong reply.
- [Patentability Criteria in India: Novelty, Inventive Step and Industrial Applicability](https://leegtech.in/blog/patentability-criteria-india/): What makes an invention patentable in India? Novelty, inventive step, industrial applicability and the Section 3 exclusions, explained in plain language.
- [What Is a Provisional Patent Application and When Should You File One?](https://leegtech.in/blog/provisional-patent-application-india/): A provisional patent application secures an early filing date in India. Learn what it must contain, the 12-month deadline and when filing one makes sense.
- [How to Choose the Right Trademark Class in India (With Examples)](https://leegtech.in/blog/how-to-choose-trademark-class-india/): India uses the Nice Classification of 45 trademark classes. Learn how to pick the right classes for your goods or services, with common examples by industry.
- [Patent vs Trademark vs Copyright vs Design: Which Protection Do You Need?](https://leegtech.in/blog/patent-vs-trademark-vs-copyright-vs-design/): Patent, trademark, copyright or design? What each protects under Indian law, how long it lasts, and how to combine them for one product.
- [Private Limited Company vs LLP: Which Is Right for Your Business?](https://leegtech.in/blog/private-limited-company-vs-llp/): Private limited company or LLP? Compare ownership, funding, compliance, taxation and conversion in India to choose the right structure for your business.
- [Trademark Registration in India: The Complete Step-by-Step Process](https://leegtech.in/blog/trademark-registration-process-india/): Trademark registration in India step by step: search, classes, filing, examination, objections, opposition, registration and renewal.
- [How to File a Patent in India: A Step by Step Guide](https://leegtech.in/blog/how-to-file-a-patent-in-india/): How to file a patent in India under the Patents Act, 1970: patentability, provisional vs complete specification, filing, examination and grant.
